business.title: Prop business ledger (owner-maintained)
business.how: Settings and accounts for the Business page (tools/business.py). Log every payment in research/business/expenses.csv and every payout in research/business/payouts.csv (or: python tools/business.py add-expense / add-payout); python tools/build_business_tracker.py --sync copies them into prop_business.xlsx and back. A funded account: set stage 'funded', funded_start, and its balance (+ optional best_day, cycle_profit, payouts_n) for the payout reminder. Amounts in USD. Nothing here changes trading.

goal.name: Corvette Z06
goal.note: placeholder: about a new Z06 with tax and fees; set your own number here (usd)

tax.note: Not tax advice. Prop-firm payouts are usually paid as contractor income (1099), so income tax and self-employment tax apply; 25-35% set aside is a common rule of thumb. Ask a tax professional.

withdraw.note: default payout habit: of each payout after tax, keep 50% (goal fund), 20% back into evals, the rest spending

payout_habit.note: ask for a funded payout only once this much sits above the buffer (lit-money-batch2.md; FundedNext 0: its $1,200 cap makes waiting worthless)

planner.note: cash budget for evals (payouts add to it, fees take from it); next eval at least 5 sessions after the last start; variant t15_be_off = live LIT now (scale-in off), all3 = after the Sim check. Order: research/writeups/lit-funded-combo.md (ladder optional here)

firms.how_to_read: Every fact is {v: value, st: confirmed | unconfirmed | conflict, src: [source keys], n: note}. confirmed = the firm's own page (or several independent sources) agree; conflict = sources disagree, the newest firm-page value is given; unconfirmed = one third-party source or not found. Prices and codes change weekly: always verify at checkout. LIT numbers come from research/lit/funded_firms.json (exact live LIT trades of 2026, H1 = Jan-Jun picked, H2 = Jul-Oct check: quote H2). firms.name: MyFundedFutures (MFFU)
firms.summary: Your firm. Builder 50K is the eval the bot trades now. Bots allowed when they run your own settings; NinjaTrader supported. 1 sim-funded Builder 50K per person.

bots.v: allowed when set to your own parameters, with oversight; HFT and sim-fill exploits banned. A few third-party guides say 'semi-automated only'

copy_trading.v: copying between your own accounts is reported as allowed by third parties; MFFU's page bans copying other traders and copying that 'mirrors, copies or coordinates trades for an unfair advantage'. Hedging across accounts banned.
copy_trading.n: ask support in writing before the 25K copies the 50K

account_caps.v: 1 active sim-funded Builder 50K per person; up to 5 sim-funded on 25K/50K plans (Rapid page); 3 sim-funded Rapid EOD (MFFU on X); whether the caps are shared across plans is not stated anywhere

codes.n: the owner's real price; use it again

codes.off: 20% Rapid EOD (Aug 2026); one page claims 50% on all plans

codes.n: very large claim, no official backing
shows MFFU runs a January sale

sales.v: codes run all year (5-50% off); January sales (JAN40 in 2025); Black Friday / Cyber Monday is when most futures firms run their biggest codes (late Nov - early Dec). No MFFU Black Friday code was found for 2025.

when.v: Builder: after 5 sim payouts (the sim-funded stage ends at payout 5); one source says 5 sim payouts totalling $10K. Rapid: a $10,000 day triggers a risk review and a possible move (profit above it forfeited). Pro: 3 consecutive payouts or a profit milestone. Otherwise a Risk Manager invites you after consistent profit.

how.v: a Risk Manager reaches out with an invitation; KYC (identity) is required; live trading needs the owner present (MFFU requires the trader to be present for live; automated trading on live must follow CME rules)

changes.v: Builder live: daily payouts, $250 minimum, 80% split, no consistency rule; soft daily loss $1,000 stays; $2,000 EOD trailing max loss that becomes static once the floor reaches $0; 'The Reserve' = sim-funded profit MFFU holds while you trade live; you pay the live account's costs (data, commissions); 1 live account; a live breach means a 21-day wait before a new live account; news allowed but strongly discouraged (orders may not be honoured)

closes_others.v: not stated by MFFU or any source found
closes_others.n: ask support: does a live move end my other sim-funded accounts?

risk_rules.v: $1,000 soft daily loss; $2,000 EOD trailing max loss (static at $0); contract cap set by the risk team (not published); intraday only, flat by 16:10 ET

reports.v: third-party guides say rules tighten after the move and KYC is required; no complaints pattern found in this search

max_loss.v: $2,000 EOD trailing (moves only at the close, from the closing-balance high); locks at $50,100; open losses count in real time

daily_loss.v: $1,000 soft: trading paused for the rest of the session, account stays open

inactivity.v: no trade for 7 calendar days can close the account

hours.v: flat by 16:10 ET, no overnight, no weekend; you flatten yourself on holiday early closes

buffer.v: $2,100 (first payout needs $500 above it: balance +$2,600, and 48 h after the first trade)

consistency.v: best day <= 50% of the cycle's profit

news.v: allowed in eval and sim-funded (Builder is the exception to the Tier-1 rule)
